reviews.review: This games the space bomb diggity forsure

My Score: 8/10 (Not for Noob players who dont take seriously or never read/Hear the story lines)

High lights:
 - Great Story line up ( Deluxe pack is just a first chapter and i am waiting for the single player DLC but i 
    think there is nothing out yet or there will not be any)
 - Good screen play and never miss to surprise at anytime like alien technologies, villain characters, the 
    politics and so on....
 - Its the major one that the game play includes  of role playing, action, adventure, puzzle solving, 
   Emotional/sentiments,.... like a mixed experience everyone will get...
 - Fair game physics, grapix, Lighting(some point not good)...

Flaws:
 - 1 or 2 times the mission marker really bad/inappropriate
 - The cut scenes really making us mad (Landing Tempest and cluster to cluster travel) as repeating and so 
    irritating...
 - I personally felt the garson's Murder case should reveal the suspect in this chapter itself since there is no DLC i am so disappointed.
The Mass Effect Series is one of the best series I've ever played. Even with the quirks and bugs that this game has, it's still a solid game.
This game really sucks me in, great story, characters and enviroment. Really recommend it.

This is not the best of Mass Effects out there. Is it still pretty alright? Yes, it is.
You get the satisfaction of space exploration and your squad mates stories. Explorable plantes are huge and can get overwhelming a bit.
Story is okay, perhaps a bit underwhelming, but certainly not awful. The game kept me playing, 79h for casual completionist is great playtime for the price (on steam sale).
There are technical problems though. I specifically encountered following:
fps drops in cut scenes and certain environments (rtx 2070s) (quite frequent)
screen flickering on rare occasions (rare)
spawning enemies in unreachable locations (once)
not spawning enemies making the goal unreachable (once)
not being able to leave 'combat' therefore unable to speak to NPCs or save game (rare)
facial animations are very weak even funny looking (frequent)
